flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/TS/{page/TS.tsx,form/TSForm.tsx,form/TSDetails.tsx}, context/OptionsContext.tsx, utils/{constant.ts,validation/TS/TS.ts}; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/suspensionreason/SuspensionReason.java (column no_of_days_for_revival). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Status Fully paid, 2 points. The Apply TS screen in the staff portal loads the suspension code drop-down from the suspensionreasonlist endpoint and shows the number of days from column no_of_days_for_revival as soon as a code is picked. Two things to keep in mind: the code list is limited by a hardcoded UI allow-list APPLY_TS_ALLOWED (13 codes), and the active-status filter is commented out (OptionsContext.tsx:282), so inactive codes would also appear if they exist in the table. The content of ocms_suspension_reason (codes and days per environment) cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict of this story.
recommendation: Can be claimed. Note: the active-status filter is commented out and the code allow-list lives in the UI

steps.step: Officer has selected notices and the Apply TS screen opens with the selected notices
steps.detail: TS.tsx loads the notice list from batch.TS (:74-86) and passes it to TSForm; TSForm only renders TSList and TSDetails when haveNotices is true (TSForm.tsx:297-301, 323-327). Selecting the notices belongs to another story.

steps.step: The Suspension Code field is a drop-down listing TS codes
steps.detail: TSDetails calls setOptions type TS filtered by reasonOfSuspension IN APPLY_TS_ALLOWED (13 codes) and suspensionSource=OCMS (TSDetails.tsx:45-62; constant.ts:111-112). CB_SUSPENSION POSTs suspensionreasonlist with suspensionType TS and builds the label 'code - description' (OptionsContext.tsx:277-302). A DropdownInput with showFilter renders it (TSDetails.tsx:81-98). The status 'A' filter is commented out (OptionsContext.tsx:282): inactive codes are not filtered in the UI. Table content per environment cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After a code is picked, the number of suspension days for that code is displayed
steps.detail: A useEffect reads suspension_code_data.data.noOfDaysForRevival and fills day_no (TSDetails.tsx:66-74); the 'Number of Days' field shows it (:101-110). The value comes from column no_of_days_for_revival (SuspensionReason.java:52-53). If a code has no value, day_no becomes an empty string (:72) and the officer must type it.

steps.step: A Suspension Code must be selected before proceeding
steps.detail: The yup rule suspension_code is required with message 'Please select suspension code.' (TS.ts:34, 61-70; TSDetails.tsx:84 isRequired). Validation is UI-only; the staff-apply-suspension endpoint does not reject an empty code with that message.
